responder.description: Who authors the response turns of a chat job: oracle (default; stateless LLM API call over inlined context) or agent (fresh agent session with file access per turn; never dispatched to an LLM API)

model.description: LLM model to use for this job

effort.description: Effort level for claude agent jobs; passed to the claude CLI as --effort (claude owns the accepted levels)

provider.description: Agent CLI provider for agent jobs; falls back to flow.interactive_provider (default claude)

template.description: Template name for generating the job prompt

skill.description: Skill name to inject into the agent context (resolved via skills package)

skill_sequence.description: List of skills to execute in sequence

depends_on.description: List of job IDs that must complete before this job runs

include.description: Files or globs to include as context in the job prompt

pinned_context.description: Files placed in a stable cached region of Anthropic chat requests with a dedicated cache_control breakpoint; append new entries to the end. Anthropic oracle-chat only

source_block.description: Reference to a named block in another job to use as input

source_file.description: Path to source file for context

memory.description: Whether to inject related memories into the prompt (default: true)

strip_comments.description: Strip code comments from generated context before sending to the LLM (default: true). Oracle-only concern: a no-op on responder: agent chats (agents read raw files)

no_cache.description: Disable provider prompt caching for this job's LLM calls (default: caching enabled). Only worthwhile for large-context jobs that run exactly once

repository.description: Git repository URL for worktree creation

inline.description: Controls which content types are inlined vs uploaded. Oracle-only concern: responder: agent chats read dependencies from disk and ignore inlining

on_complete_status.description: Status to set on dependent jobs when this job completes

notify_on_complete.description: Channel to notify when job reaches terminal state

auto_complete.description: For chat jobs: transition to completed instead of pending_user (bypassing review gate)

retry_transient.description: Number of retries for transient failures (default 1)

updated_at.description: When the job was last modified

source_plan.description: Reference to the plan this job was generated from

recipe_name.description: Name of the recipe used to create this job

generate_plan_from.description: Generate a new plan from this job's output

git_changes.description: Include git diff/status in job context

gather_concept_notes.description: Include related concept notes in context

gather_concept_plans.description: Include related concept plans in context

rules_file.description: Path to rules file for agent behavior

used_rules_file.description: Archived rules file used during last execution

note_ref.description: Reference to a notebook entry for context

signal_target.description: Named signal target (contact or group) for outbound messages

title: Grove Flow Job
description: Schema for Grove Flow job frontmatter in markdown files.
